name: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger Vol. 5.5
original_name: グリザイア ファントムトリガー Vol. 5.5
source:
Three months have passed since Arisaka Shiori started her somewhat special position as a teacher at Mihama Academy, the "school of assassins", when she is forced to take an objective look at herself. Does she want to continue in this job? Which world will she choose to live in?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1039960/Grisaia_Phantom_Trigger_Vol55/]Steam[/url]]
